rules.rationale: A16 removes the FallbackHome progress animation and, only when HOME resolves to ResolverActivity, selects the final A13 launcher package com.uncube.launcher3. The current implementation validates ResolveInfo/activityInfo, requires the preferred package to exist instead of choosing an arbitrary fallback candidate, and catches runtime failures.
rules.necessity: Required to leave FallbackHome and consistently launch the BlueStacks home when multiple HOME activities are installed.
rules.performance: HOME candidate enumeration and preferred-activity update occur only during fallback boot resolution. Removing the animation avoids rendering work; the 100 ms retry loop remains startup-only.
rules.security: Settings uses privileged PackageManager authority to set the default HOME. Exact package matching prevents an unrelated launcher from becoming preferred when the intended package is absent.
validation_evidence: Final A16 FallbackHome was reviewed through candidate enumeration, preferred activity registration, null handling and finish/retry behavior. Runtime clean-Data launcher validation remains mandatory.

rules.rationale: A16 uses Formatter.FLAG_IEC_UNITS for the storage summary at the unchanged StorageUtils responsibility boundary.
rules.necessity: Required so Settings storage totals use binary units consistent with guest image sizing and BlueStacks UI expectations.
rules.security: No security impact; display semantics only.

rules.rationale: A16 guards both lifecycle registration and unregistration when LocalBluetoothManager or its event manager is unavailable, preserving the A13 BSSettings accessibility crash fix.
rules.necessity: Required on products without a ready Bluetooth stack so opening accessibility settings does not crash.
rules.security: No authority change; fail-open behavior skips hearing-aid callbacks when the manager is absent.
validation_evidence: Target diff symmetrically guards onStart and onStop callback operations.

rules.rationale: A16 manifest exposes the six BlueStacks aliases for location, accessibility, storage, accounts, about phone and account sync, adapted to current target activities and fragment metadata.
rules.necessity: Required by host/UI shortcuts that open specific Settings destinations without navigating the full homepage.
rules.security: Aliases are exported and therefore externally invocable. Their target activities must continue to enforce Settings permissions and user restrictions; no sensitive fragment should trust caller extras.
validation_evidence: Final A16 AndroidManifest.xml contains all six alias names and current targetActivity/FRAGMENT_CLASS pairs.

rules.rationale: A16 preserves the bst.config.modify_settings gate, compact BlueStacks top-level page, hidden search/action-bar and unsupported gesture, keyboard, pointer, reset, update and multi-user surfaces. Removed/renamed A16 controllers are adapted at current Java/Kotlin paths, and the 100 ms FallbackHome retry is retained without copying commented-out XML entries as active UI.
rules.necessity: Required to present the constrained App Player Settings experience while allowing the standard Android page when the property gate is disabled.
rules.performance: Static property reads occur once per class load. The compact homepage creates fewer preference/controller surfaces and skips physical-keyboard background UI updates while enabled.
rules.security: Hides reset, update, multi-user and device-control surfaces from normal navigation but is not an authorization boundary. Direct aliases/intents and underlying services must still enforce policy.
validation_evidence: A13 12-file patch was compared with A16 manifest, compact XML and all current controllers, including the Kotlin SystemUpdate controller and separate MultiUser controller. Settings build and runtime navigation remain pending.
